title: Geologic map of the Aiken quadrangle, Aiken County, South Carolina
citation: Nystrom, P.G., Jr., 2006, Geologic map of the Aiken quadrangle, Aiken County, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Geologic Quadrangle Map GQM-55, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: OCR of a map sheet. Cross section A-A' (vertical exaggeration 20) read from page image tiles: 13 drill holes with unit intervals as elevations read off the feet scale (+/-2 ft, inferred). Many holes are drawn from above the profile (projected); their tops are not recorded. Hole 2-902 is drawn entirely above the profile and is left out. No horizontal scale, so no distances or contact points. Huber burrow size printed '| to 2 cm' (OCR) recorded as 1 to 2 cm, inferred.
